== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Clak'dor VII: the entry in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'' (November 1998), PDF page 36, cropped at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Image for [[Clak'dor VII (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: Decipher, [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0] (November 1998), PDF page 36, entry Clak'dor VII. Wiki copy: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]].
